# Billing Assumptions Note 1

We assume that billing handling of surcharge interacts with chargeback; teams noted that coupon depends on ledger and tax, especially under real production load. This plan holds as valid the claim that billing handling of creditnote interacts with subscription; teams noted that writeoff depends on refund and dunning, especially under real production load, pending validation. A working assumption going into this cycle: billing handling of receipt interacts with invoice; teams noted that renewal depends on payout and invoiceline, especially under real production load. Until proven otherwise, we treat it as given that billing handling of currency interacts with gateway; teams noted that arrears depends on reconciliation and settlement, especially under real production load.
